practiceReport.beatComment: Brosmer will operate as the team's No. 3 option at QB for the second straight week. He will only be eligible to enter the game if both starter Kirk Cousins and primary backup Carson Wentz are forced out of the contest.

practiceReport.name: Andrew Van Ginkel
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 81% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Van Ginkel's practice reps were limited Wednesday and Thursday while managing a quadriceps injury that he sustained in Week 10 against the Packers. He was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for the veteran edge rusher to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. In Van Ginkel's four outings since the Vikings' Week 6 bye, he has accumulated 14 tackles (eight solo), including 4.5 sacks, one forced fumble and one fumble recovery.

practiceReport.name: T.J. Hockenson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: In his return from a one-game absence, Hockenson finished second on the team in receiving yards behind Justin Jefferson's 86. Hockenson showed promising chemistry with Kirk Cousins after the veteran TE sat out Cousins' return to Minnesota during the Week 10 win over Green Bay. Cousins was under center for the Vikings in the 2023 regular season, when Hockenson set career highs with 95 catches for 960 yards. Hockenson hasn't surpassed 455 yards in a regular season since, though he's on pace to do so this year, with 41 catches for 383 yards and three touchdowns through nine appearances heading into a Week 12 home game against the Falcons.

practiceReport.name: Christian Darrisaw
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (94% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: Darrisaw was sidelined with a shoulder injury prior to halftime, but he was able to return to the field following the break. The 27-year-old is back in his starting role at left tackle against the 49ers.

practiceReport.name: Blake Cashman
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (8th NFL season, 95% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Cashman will end up missing one game (Week 10 against the Packers) while in the league's concussion protocol, and his return means Ivan Pace will revert to a rotational role at inside linebacker for Sunday's contest. Cashman has accumulated 76 tackles (41 solo), including a career-high-tying 4.5 sacks, seven pass defenses and one fumble recovery across eight regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Joshua Metellus
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 99% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Metellus was added to the Vikings' practice report Friday due to a shoulder issue, but the injury won't prevent the seventh-year pro from suiting up for Sunday's NFC North showdown. He has 58 tackles (29 solo), including 0.5 sacks, and four pass defenses through eight regular-season games.

practiceReport.name: Carson Wentz
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (11th NFL season, 89% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Kyler Murray (hamstring) is out for another week but may eventually replace Wentz as the No. 2 quarterback. Wentz's miserable performance against the Bills last week likely was a factor in the Vikings trading for Cousins.

practiceReport.name: Jeshaun Jones
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Jones -- who was managing a shoulder injury during Week 11 prep -- was a full participant in Friday's session, which was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Sunday's contest. He was signed to the Vikings' 53-man roster Wednesday to give the team more depth at wide receiver while Jordan Addison recovers from a thumb injury. Jones figures to be limited to a rotational role on offense while serving as a contributor on special teams.
